title: Northgate Optical Vision Plan Allowance Rules
content:
Northgate Optical bills only the vision plans it accepts — VSP, EyeMed, Davis Vision and Superior Vision. A plan that is not one of them is not billed, and the member pays privately.

## Allowance credits

When the job's vision plan is an accepted plan, the plan's share is posted on the order date as credits against the charges it covers:

- an **insurance allowance credit against the base-lens charge** equal to that charge less the lens design's lens copay for the plan — nothing when the copay is at least the charge;
- an **insurance allowance credit against the frame charge** of the frame charge up to the plan's frame allowance.

Material upgrades, coatings and options are not covered by any plan and are paid by the member.

**One allowance per charge.** Each covered charge receives at most one allowance credit. Whether a charge already has one is read from the job's credit entries that point back to that exact charge and carry the insurance allowance reason; a credit for another reason against the same charge does not count as an allowance.

**What member services does not decide.** Plan eligibility, authorization numbers and benefit frequency are confirmed by the optical counter with the plan. Member services cannot check or override a plan's decision.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Job | Base-lens charge | Lens copay | Lens allowance | Frame charge | Frame allowance | Frame allowance credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Premium Progressive Lenses, VSP | 149.99 | 95.00 | 54.99 | 160.00 | 130.00 | 130.00 |
| Northgate Single Vision Lenses, Davis Vision | 39.99 | 20.00 | 19.99 | 85.00 | 100.00 | 85.00 |
| A base-lens charge of 20.00 with a 25.00 copay (illustrative figures) | 20.00 | 25.00 | nothing | — | — | — |

In the first row the member pays the 95.00 copay on the lenses and 30.00 of the frame; in the second row the frame charge is below the allowance, so the whole frame charge is credited.

### Basis Q&A

**Does a plan cover a Trivex upgrade?** No. Material upgrades are paid by the member.

**May a second allowance be posted against a frame charge that already has one?** No. Each covered charge receives at most one allowance credit.

**Can member services approve a benefit the plan declined?** No. The plan's decision is confirmed by the optical counter and is not overridden by member services.
